findings.message: The page at 0x10047 is cut short after 1282 bytes of 65307 bytes; decoders drop it with its packets.

The logical stream 0x0000FFFF has no end-of-stream page: its last page at 0x10047 sets the flag but is damaged, so decoders drop it, and it ends before the end of the data, so the file was probably cut short or not finished.
